svg.title: It still has order at least s + 1. Its represented tensor is unchanged, since C1 −V = u −C1 −C2 −D = u. Its remaining contraction is removed, since HV = HX −C2 −HD = HX −C2 −Y = 0. Apply the independent-block division separately to the six E2 coefficients of V . This gives g ∈E2 ⊗E2, of order at least s, whose two curl contractions equal u. All identities hold at zero momentum as analytic identities, as well as at nonzero real momentum. For clarity the width and norm losses can also be followed without any existence convention.
